writing.exampleCaption: Without Box, this enum would need infinite size.
writing.explanation: A recursive type has no fixed size, because each level would contain another whole level. Box has a known pointer size, so putting the recursive part behind one makes the type representable. Box also lets a function return a trait object whose concrete size is not known at the call site.
writing.feedback: Box<List> makes the recursive field pointer-sized and the type finite.
